serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Annalie.face.normal #bot.Expression.Clear Lady Annalie: Welcome back after a long time- #Annalie.face.shocked Lady Annalie: -ACK!{{punch}} You: What’s the matter? #Annalie.face.sad Lady Annalie: You know, Anon, if you wanted your girlfriend to have hair like mine, you should have… #bot.Expression.Angry #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: …just asked me out~ Bot: I hope that’s just one of your jokes, Annalie. #bot.Expression.Clear Lady Annalie: Of course it is, but you must admit that the resemblance is just uncanny~ #bot.Expression.Shock Lady Annalie: We totally look like sisters right now, maybe that’s what he wanted all along~ Bot: Is that true? You: Of course not! Don’t listen to her, {f_botName}! #bot.Expression.VeryShock Lady Annalie: I knew his tastes were twisted, but I would never imagine that he would try something like this so openly~ #bot.Expression.Blush Lady Annalie: What do you say, {f_botName}? Are you ready for some 2 on 1 action with your newly found twin~? Bot: N-No…{{wi}} I don’t think…{{wi}} {f_botName} looks like she’s about to fry her circuits, I need to stop Annalie before this gets out of hand! #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.surprised You: Alright Annalie, you had your fun already. {f_botName}’s teasing threshold is even smaller than mine. #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: That’s exactly why I can’t stop~ It’s too much fun! Lady Annalie: I should have some lotion in the back, wait for me here and I will go get it~
